description: This file defines the implementation of a feature expression used within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically representing feature-based conditions in query expressions.

classes.name: FeatureExpressionImpl
classes.description: Implements a feature-based expression for querying, encapsulating a feature ID and providing visitor pattern methods.

methods.name: FeatureExpressionImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the featureId with a non-null value.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for existence field expressions and delegates the visit to it.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a general field expression visitor and delegates the visit to it.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this expression.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on the featureId.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on featureId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the feature expression, including its featureId.
